title: What a Prompt Is
brief: A silent animation for the section that names the word 'prompt': Claude Desktop runs code on your own machine from instructions, an instruction is called a prompt, anything you type is one — then the window itself, with 'How can you help?' typed at the composer and the model starting to work. Kinetic-type shots with flat-vector figures, one full-frame session window, light showroom skin, nothing on screen longer than five words.
angle: The word is the whole lesson. Everything you will ever do with this tool is typing one of these and pressing Enter.

segments.prompt: Two shots: Claude Desktop runs code on your own machine, and you only ever give it instructions

beats.heading: Code runs on your machine
beats.narration: Claude Desktop can run code on the machine in front of you, not somewhere far away.

beats.heading: You just give instructions
beats.narration: You never touch the code yourself. You give it an instruction and it does the work.

segments.prompt: Three shots naming the word: what is an instruction, it is called a prompt, anything you type is one

beats.heading: So what is an instruction?
beats.narration: So what is an instruction, exactly? The word matters, because everything else builds on it.

beats.heading: It is called a prompt
beats.narration: In technical terms an instruction is called a prompt. That is the word to keep.

beats.heading: Anything you type is one
beats.narration: Whatever you type into Claude is a prompt. A question, a command, a whole plan.

segments.prompt: The window itself: type How can you help at the composer, hit Enter, and watch it start working

session.hint: type a prompt and press Enter

events.text: I can read the files on this machine, write code and run it.
lines: Ask for something and I will do it step by step.

beats.heading: The window
beats.narration: This is the window. One box at the bottom, waiting for whatever you want to say.

beats.heading: Type it
beats.narration: Type something simple, like how can you help, then hit Enter and hand it over.

beats.heading: It starts working
beats.narration: The moment you hit Enter it starts working. The line underneath says it is running.

beats.heading: It answers
beats.narration: And it answers in plain words, telling you what it can actually do for you here.

beats.heading: The whole loop
beats.narration: One prompt in, one answer back. That is the whole loop you will use all day.

segments.prompt: Two closing shots: the model reads what you meant, then it starts doing the work

beats.heading: It reads what you meant
beats.narration: Underneath, the model is reading your words and working out what you actually meant.

beats.heading: Then it gets to work
beats.narration: Then it plans, and it starts doing the thing you asked for on your machine.
